title: Show a toast message
params.timer: Auto-close countdown in seconds. `0` means it will not auto-close
params.buttonCallbackFn: Callback function content, in string form. It will be automatically parsed and executed
deprecated: Please use the {@link SYS_Message.showToastMessage} method instead
